name: create-pod
title: Create Pod
description: Rent a GPU/CPU pod. BILLABLE from creation until stop/terminate: state the hourly price before creating. GPU selection is the gpu object: gpu.id takes a catalog GPU type id (e.g. "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090"), verified via list-gpu-types, and gpu.count sets the GPU count; cloud/data-center choice constrains stock. Call describe-tool for the full argument schema before the first use.
